title.narrative: GCERF Enhanced Resilience to Violent Extremism (Sahel & Littoral States)

description.narrative:
The objective of the support to GCERF is to strengthen local community resilience against the threat of violent extremism. GCERF channels the support provided by its donors to projects implemented by local civil society organisations. The Norwegian support is softly earmarked to GCERF’s activity in Niger, Burkina Faso, Chad, Mali, Ghana and Mauritania. Through an amendment in 2025, the scope of the agreement was extended to also cover GCERF’s work with rehabilitation and reintegration of former IS-related detainees in the camps in northeast Syria.
Target Groups: - Group 1: Internally and externally displaced young men and women living in host communities in rural areas. - Group 2: Bereaved households due to extremist, self-defence militias, or government forces operations. - Group 3: Local authority actors, including customary chiefs and religious leaders to enable existing structures to build sustainable pockets of peace.
All GCERF's projects have a gender equality cross-cutting theme to ensure a conflict sensitive and inclusive response. In addition, each grantee benefits from tailored trainings for example on gender sensitive programming.
